debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought oscillators (RSI 80.78, Stoch 87.6), zero momentum confirmation (MACD/Stoch/PSAR flat), hostile macro (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals), and weak fundamentals (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk) make immediate entry high-risk into resistance.
